page.overview:
What is Bad Seed?

Bad Seed is the eighth song from 1997's album ReLoad. It was written by James Hetfield, Lars Ulrich and Kirk Hammett, with a length of 4:05.

Come clean, fess up Tell all, spill gut Off the veil, stand revealed Show the cards, bring it on, break the seal

Ladies and gentlemen, step right up And see the man who told the truth

Swing the noose again Pierce the apple skin You bit more than you need Now you're choking on the bad seed On the bad seed Choking
